description_en: Call ListDbfsAttachableEcsInstances to query the list of ECS instances that can be attached to a DBFS file system
description_zh: 调用ListDbfsAttachableEcsInstances查询数据库文件系统可挂载的ECS实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs list-dbfs-attachable-ecs-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --filter-key InstanceName --filter-value autotest1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDbfsAttachableEcsInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. To view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions, see [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)
parameters.help_zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The filter key used when querying resources.

Use with FilterValue. Valid values: InstanceId or InstanceName.

If you specify InstanceId, the system filters by ECS instance ID. If you specify InstanceName, the system filters by ECS instance name
parameters.help_zh:
查询资源时的筛选键。

与FilterValue配合使用，取值必须为InstanceId或InstanceName。

传入InstanceId则根据ECS实例ID进行筛选，传入InstanceName则根据ECS实例名称进行筛选
parameters.name: filter_key

parameters.help_en:
The filter value used when querying resources.

Use with FilterKey
parameters.help_zh:
查询资源时的筛选值。

与FilterKey配合使用
parameters.name: filter_value
